The '''Zuggit system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zuggit [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="EAOC" /> In "[[The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 32|thirty-second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, published in [[1997]], ''[[Star Wars]]'' actor [[Anthony Daniels]] made a tongue-in-cheek reference to a "twelve [[Foot/Legends|foot]], twin-headed, [[Color/Legends|magenta]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] from the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Zuggit]]."<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|32|The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column}}</ref>
